dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Wh-What? My body suddenly... All my strength is...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It can't be... My eyes are blurring, too...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Am I finally out of time?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I knew this moment would come...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But now?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I must go.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Go? Wait... I know Bucciarati and his crew have a goal.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Where is he trying to go?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I'm sure the boss wants to find that out.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Pardon me.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Can I lend you a hand?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: It's totally up to you, though.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What? You're still here?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I'm fine.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Go run along somewhere.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: But... and excuse me if I'm being presumptuous,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but I think it might be hard for you to cross that road alone.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I really don't mind lending you my shoulder.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I mean, if you don't mind...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Well...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: That might not be such a bad idea.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: How far would you like to go?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Um... Just to the entrance of the Colosseum.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: The entrance of the Colosseum...

dialogue.name: JoJo-EpTitle,Sign
dialogue.speech: Episodio His Name Is Diavolo

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: There's no time. Just to the other side of the road... Please...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Look out!

dialogue.name: Driver
dialogue.speech: You stupid-a*s drunk!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Are you okay?! Where were you look—

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: What? Why is Bucciarati so cold?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Sorry about that...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: This is a guardrail?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Did I run into it?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Could it be that... Bucciarati can't see anything?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: He also ignored that car hornwhen he tried to cross the road.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Does that mean he can't hear, either?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: That wound on your throat...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Were you hurt during that scuffle earlier?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Actually, it looks like that wound is from this morning or last night.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's not bleeding anymore.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: That's a strange place to be wounded.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: He can somehow see it clearly. But it's under my collar...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: He's looking right at it!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: At the wound that Risotto gave me!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Oh, you picked that up for me.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Thanks. I appreciate it.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Well... Ready to go?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Okay... Let's go.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: He can hear me, too.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: But something seems off, for just being hurt in a fight.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: What's going on?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: That's Guido Mista!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Damn! I took too much time.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Of course he'd show up.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Is something wrong?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: We haven't finished crossing yet.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: No, um...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Sorry, the cut on my neck started bleeding a little...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: He's heading this way!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I apologize for being selfish, but I'm in a hurry.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I need to hurry up and cross.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: No!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Don't stand up!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I mean... There's another car coming.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Let's cross once it passes.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: No, that's on the other side of the road.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: We can cross.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Come on.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Let me cross.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: N-No... Mista's coming!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I'm just going to have to eliminate him right here...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Right now!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Bring, ring, ring, ring, ring...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I wonder what that sound was.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Bring, ring, ring, ring, ring, ring-a-ling-ring-a-ling-ding...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What the hell are you doing?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: What did you just say?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Bring, ring, ring, ring, ring, ring-a-ling-ring-a-ling-ding...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Why am I getting a call right now?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: He's going to figure out who I am!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You're...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Bring, ring, ring, ring, ring...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: You friggin' dumbass!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Why the hell are you calling me right now?!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Do you want him to find out?!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Trish!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Don't come outside yet!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: The danger's not fully gone. Get back in the turtle!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: You don't understand. He's here!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I started getting that feeling again.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The same thing I felt in Sardinia...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Who... are you?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: The person in front of me...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You're...

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&HD&\c&HCCE&}Rumble

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Trish!

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: I can feel him! He's nearby.

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: The boss is nearby!

dialogue.name: Mista
dialogue.speech: He's nearby?

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: You don't know exactly where, though?

dialogue.name: Trish
dialogue.speech: He just suddenly appeared...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: But I don't know where.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Thank goodness. You're safe.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Well done. You did excellent work.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: This is why you're my most trusted and number one subordinate.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Don't worry.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati is looking at you right now, but he doesn't actually see you.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: What do you mean?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I don't know how this happened, but Bucciarati is already a corpse.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: His heartbeat has stopped, and he's not breathing properly.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: He can't see, and his eardrums ruptured in his battle with Secco.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: All he can see right now, Doppio, is the shape of your soul.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: All he can hear is the energy of your soul.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: He can't see objects like guardrails,

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: and all he can see in cars are the souls of the drivers.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: What's wrong, Trish?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Did something happen?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: My daughter's soul and mine have a similar scent.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: That's what I gave you just now.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: All Bucciarati sees is the form of my daughter!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Get Bucciarati to lead you to whatever he was seeking.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Have him take you there!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Trish...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Sorry... I'm tired, so I spaced out a bit.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: But thank goodness you're safe, Bucciarati.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Yeah... More importantly, was there a young man nearby?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Oh, I saw him rush off somewhere in a hurry.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: More importantly, Bucciarati, let's hurry to our destination.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You're right. I hate to bother you, but could you lend me a hand?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I can't seem to gather enough strength...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Yes,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: of course.

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: {\fad(,)\c&HFDFEEB&\c&HAF&}Diavolo

dialogue.name: Sign
dialogue.speech: {\fad(,)\c&HFDFEEB&\c&HAF&}Emperor Crimson

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's rather small, but Trish, I have a house in the suburbs of Naples.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Once all this is over... if you don't have anywhere to go...

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You can live there.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: There's a school nearby, as well as a great restaurant.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: It's close to the beach, too.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: You've had nothing but horrible things happen to you,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but you still have a chance to enjoy a new life.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Thanks. But more importantly right now, where should I head next?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Go up those stairs...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Upstairs?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Don't turn your head, Doppio!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Keep going as though you haven't noticed anything!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: There's someone here.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Upstairs, behind one of the stone pillars.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Someone is watching you!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: It appears that his goal was to meet with someone.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: But who could it possibly be? I haven't the slightest idea...

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Boss, how do you know they're here?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: And if I don't turn around and look, I won't be able to tell who they are.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Look at Bucciarati's eyes. That should be enough.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: He's reflecting in Bucciarati's eyes right now.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Don't move!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Stop right there.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Take even a step up those stairs, and our deal is off.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: You're right! There's someone hidden behind one of the pillars!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: My name is Bruno Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: I came this far because I trusted you when you said

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: you had a way to defeat the boss!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I know that.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: But before we get to that, who's that next to you?

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: There's nothing about them anywhere in my records!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: And there shouldn't be!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: Trish doesn't belong to the organization, and I only met her a few days ago.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: But as you can see, she's one of us.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Trish? That sounds like a girl's name.

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Sounds like?

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: This isn't good... He's going to find us out, Boss!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Calm down. Listen to me. This is what you're going to say:

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: "Do you have a problem with me being a girl?" Go on, say it, Doppio!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: Do you have a problem with me being a girl?!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I guess I said something I shouldn't have.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: It's a bit dark in here, so I couldn't see you well.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Is she a Stand user?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Of course! But enough questions! What I want to know is, who are you?

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: Let's just get to the point of this meeting!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: No, not yet. I want to see her Stand.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Trish! Move slowly.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I have no data on you,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: but if you show me your Stand from there, I'll trust you.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: B-Boss...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Who the hell is he?

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: He's definitely got experience fighting.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: He's even thinking about a Stand's range...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Who could he possibly be? I really have no idea...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Well? Hurry and show me from that spot.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Move slowly, as if you're lifting up your skirt.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: That's... It can't be!Why does he have that?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: That arrow... There's no doubt about it.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: That's the arrow from back then!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Wh-What's this ominous murderous intent I feel?

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: It feels like someone's pointing a knife right at my heart...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I've felt something like this before...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Don't tell me—

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: No, wait... That's right. There is one person I can think of.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: He used the arrow to track me down...

dialogue.name: Both
dialogue.speech: He's—

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: In Egypt, I dug up the arrows that awaken Stand abilities within people.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I knew the moment I saw them

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: that these arrows had some mysterious power.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: An old woman named Enyaba who had two right hands

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: told me she'd tell me how the arrows worked in return for shooting some.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I figured one would be more than enough,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: so I sold the other five for a handsome sum.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: Come to think of it, that old woman said something rather bizarre...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: The arrow chooses people,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: and those people are attracted to one another like magnets.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: In the s, me and my old friend Jotaro Kujo were investigating

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: these arrows that brought out one's Stand abilities.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: We heard about a young man who had dug up the other arrows,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: and we split up to be more efficient in searching for him.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Jotaro went to America and Asia.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I went to Europe and Africa.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: And I managed to find out that one of the arrows was

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: in a region of Italy where drug-related crimes had suddenly skyrocketed.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I investigated an unusual region where drug crimes

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: involving young people and their victims had increased twenty times,

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: and I knew I was finally close.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: But...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: My organization was nearing perfection after just a few years.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: My subordinates swore their loyalty to me.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: I had men hiding in all branches of society.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I had a notion that someone was trying to track me down.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: In the end, I would finish them off myself.

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: That's the most surefire way.

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I'd already decided that.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: But I ended up making two big mistakes.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: My first mistake was that this crime organization was already complete.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Communications, the government, the press...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Society itself had isolated me.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: And my second and greatest mistake...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Silver Chariot!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I guess I'll tell you, since you're going to die.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: The man who had unearthed the arrows

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: had powers far more sinister than I could have ever imagined!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: The moment that anyone sees Emperor Crimson...

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: Boom

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: This ability...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Time... It...

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: ...they are no longer in this world.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Is there no hope...?

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: I'm certain that I k*lled him!

dialogue.name: Boss
dialogue.speech: To think that someone I had eliminated

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: in the past would show up again with an arrow!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Bucciarati! The one next to you is—

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Wh-What? Bucciarati!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Where'd the person next to you go?!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: They disappeared! Don't tell me...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Where did they go?!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Where did the one you brought here go?!

dialogue.name: Bruno
dialogue.speech: T-Trish...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I'm asking you who the hell that person next to you was!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I didn't hear or see anything fall, but a piece is already behind me...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: No... These movements...

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Time just skipped!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: Just like what happened in Venice!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We moved further up the stairs before we realized it!

dialogue.name: Gio
dialogue.speech: We're not gonna make it!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The man waiting for us at the Colosseum just entered the boss's range!

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: This is a test.

dialogue.name: Dopp
dialogue.speech: I've accepted this test to stand victorious against my past.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: A person grows once they are able to defeat their weaker self.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Wouldn't you agree, Jean Pierre Polnareff?

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: You're...

dialogue.name: Crunch,Sfx
dialogue.speech: {\c&H&\c&HCC&}Rumble

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Diavolo!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: It appears that no matter how much I tear apart the past,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: it still manages to wriggle up like a worm from under a rock.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: This is surprising.

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: No wonder I couldn't think of anyone who opposed me.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: How did you get here?!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: But in the end,

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: it doesn't matter how you survived after I scattered your remains in the ocean.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: What's important, Polnareff,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: is what you were trying to tell Bucciarati and his men!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Don't you dare set foot on those stairs!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I'm up here! You're down there!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Why won't you fight yourself, Polnareff?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Because you no longer have the mental capacity for it?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Or are you no longer physically able to fight?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: What are you going to use that arrow for?

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: This is impossible. I'm sure it was a kid down there!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: Diavolo... When did you get so close to me?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: You're the one below me, Polnareff!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: As long as you are below in Hell,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: it doesn't matter what you plan to do with that arrow!

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: There! Silver Chariot!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: I see your Stand ability hasn't lost any of its power.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: And it seems you've learned...

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You've figured out how to see when time has skipped by counting drops of blood.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: I see. In just a moment's difference in number...

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Your timing is genius, too.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: If I had been any closer, I would've been gravely injured.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: This is the worst...

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
dialogue.speech: I can't believe the first person to get here was Diavolo...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I won't have another chance. But I must...

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I must protect hope at all costs!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: You're already within my range!

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: You won't escape this time!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Emperor Crimson!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Now, once the passage of time resumes,

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: you won't be able to see how many drops of blood there are.

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: I've just defeated my weakerself from the past!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Take this! The passage of time will resume—

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Wh-What is this?

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: The arrow... The Stand...

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: I don't know what it's doing, but...

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Take this!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: This arrow... What is it doing to Chariot?!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: There's some kind of power behind this glow!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Time, resume!

dialogue.name: Dia
dialogue.speech: Impossible! What did you do?

dialogue.name: JoJo-main
dialogue.speech: The arrow does more than just draw out Stand abilities?

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: This is my gamble to keep the arrow from Diavolo.

dialogue.name: Pol
dialogue.speech: I didn't want to show him that,

dialogue.name: JoJo-internal/narrator
